newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures settled firmer on Friday, supported by the yen's slip against the dollar, traders said. The futures came off early highs as short-covering by private investors lost steam later in the day, they said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.2 yen per kg higher. Most-active benchmark August was up 0.7 yen at 155.1 yen.
Activity was lacklustre. "Private investors remained wary of taking fresh positions as the market suffered from a lack of incentives," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
Caution grew after the benchmark August reached 156 yen.
